resources.string: Catch your dreams before they fade.
Set your alarm. When you wake up, just talk. Remnant captures your dreams before they slip away.
Morning voice (optional). Cloud voices send your first name to Google to make the greeting.
Remnant sends nothing to make it

Cloud voices are made by Google\'s text-to-speech service. Selecting one sends your first name and the greeting text to Google to generate the audio -- nothing else, and no dream content ever. Stay on your phone\'s own voice and Remnant makes no text-to-speech request at all.
Take a moment\u2026 what do you remember?
Your alarm will ask what you dreamed about.\nJust talk. We\'ll handle the rest.
